=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:103, 126-127 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root command differs from its workflow template, causing the byte-for-byte template parity test to fail.
  WHY: `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:test_template_parity` fails, causing the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and aggregate `lint` checks to fail.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:480-481, 495-497 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: With no explicit `--repo`/`--rep`, `_push_targets` treats the first positional argument as a remote even when it is a refspec.
  WHY: A push such as `git push feature/x` or `git push HEAD:branch` is treated as an unverified destination and prompts for confirmation instead of checking the implicit default remote.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:502-512 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The bulk `_GuardTarget` appended by `_push_targets` omits `remote=remote_value`.
  WHY: A bulk target for a non-origin remote can bypass the unverified-destination check because its `remote` field is absent or empty.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:111-119 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_reject` leaves the socket timeout clamped to the remaining body-drain deadline before calling `self.send_error`.
  WHY: The error response write can time out under load, aborting delivery of the rejection response.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:428-473 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The remote destination tracking and unverified-destination confirmation behavior described by the LAST RUN DIFF is absent from the working tree.
  WHY: Pushes to non-origin remotes via `--repo` or positional remote URLs pass the guard without requesting confirmation.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:102 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_reject` lacks the `drain_body` behavior described by the LAST RUN DIFF.
  WHY: A large unauthorized request body can encounter a broken pipe because the relay closes the connection without draining it.
- changelog.d/6187-isolated-codex-agents.md:21 and README.md:1227-1228 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The documentation says confirmation is requested for a positional remote, but the implementation also treats positional refspecs as remotes.
  WHY: Operators may expect only pushes to other repositories to prompt, while ordinary `git push <refspec>` commands prompt too.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:189-196 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Adding `remote` as the eighth `_GuardTarget` field can make a future eight-positional-argument construction silently place its value in `remote` rather than the old `bulk` field.
  WHY: Current call sites use the keyword form, but a future positional construction could misalign the fields.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md, lines 103, 126, 127 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: .claude/commands/audit-plans.md contains outdated in-session wording that does not match workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md.
  WHY: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:test_template_parity asserts byte-for-byte identity between .claude/commands/audit-plans.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md. The divergence causes test_template_parity to fail in the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator CI job, failing the required lint check run and blocking pull request merge.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py, lines 112-119 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Inside _reject, self.connection.settimeout(max(0.01, deadline - time.monotonic())) progressively reduces the socket timeout during request body draining, but the socket timeout is not restored before calling self.send_error(status, "Request rejected").
  WHY: If the body drain loop consumes most of the 1.0-second deadline or finishes on a small remaining duration, the socket timeout remains clamped to as low as 10 milliseconds (0.01s). Subsequent socket write operations in send_error can raise socket.timeout on loaded runners or slow clients, aborting the connection with TCP RST instead of delivering the HTTP 400 error response.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, line 512 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In _push_targets, the bulk _GuardTarget is constructed without passing remote=remote_value, allowing target.remote to default to an empty string.
  WHY: When a push command specifies both refspecs and bulk options against an unverified remote (e.g. git push https://github.com/other/repo feature/x --all), the generated bulk target does not inherit the remote value, leaving target.remote inconsistent across targets created for the same push invocation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
